description: Cancel an inference job that is still running on a serverless endpoint. Use when the user wants to stop work in progress — a job that is taking too long, was submitted by mistake, or is no longer needed. Call it with confirm:false first for a preview. Cancelling stops the job billing for further GPU seconds, and ends the run: whatever it had not yet returned is lost and the job cannot be resumed, so submit a new one instead.
name: cancel_serverless_job
